name: Chroma
one_liner: Embedding store aimed at getting retrieval running quickly.
what_it_is: Open-source data infrastructure for AI, in its maintainers’ words, providing storage and querying of embeddings with their documents and metadata. It can run in-process against local files, so a retrieval prototype needs no server.
why_it_matters: Running in-process removes the operational step between an idea and a working retrieval loop, which is where most such projects stall. That same property is the reason it is not automatically the answer later: the embedded mode that made it easy to start is not the mode you run for many users.
suitable_for: Prototyping a retrieval loop before committing to infrastructure
Teaching and experiments where setup cost dominates
not_suitable_for: Production retrieval under concurrency, which is a different deployment
Cases where vectors belong beside relational data
Teams needing the filtering guarantees of a search-first engine
